geometry.bounds_reason: The body sizes and positions describe the visible result. The saved SolidCraft model is checked separately to confirm that shared parameters are reused instead of duplicated.

solidcraft_only.native_expectation: The saved SolidCraft design exposes d1_Panel_width, d2_Panel_2_width and shared_width; changing shared_width updates both directly-bound children and the derived half-width child without rerunning Python.
solidcraft_only.generated_relationship: Explicitly included component parameters are namespaced with the internal definition number plus readable component name (for example d1_Panel_width); unincluded child defaults stay fixed; inherited names such as shared_width remain unprefixed and are emitted once even when several child definitions use them.
solidcraft_only.saved_design_reason: Change shared_width from 80 to 100 mm in the saved native design; widths must change from [40,40,60,80,80] to [40,50,60,100,100].
solidcraft_only.mutation: Change shared_width from 80 to 100 mm in the saved native design; widths must change from [40,40,60,80,80] to [40,50,60,100,100].
